jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist / VP
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Lead Data Scientist will work hands\-on across the AI and analytics development lifecycle. The role will design analytical approaches, develop and validate models, build Generative AI and agentic workflows, and partner with data engineers and technology teams to implement scalable production solutions.


The successful candidate will combine strong data\-science expertise with practical engineering skills, enterprise implementation experience, and an understanding of governance requirements. The role will also provide technical guidance to other data scientists and help establish reusable methods, coding standards, and implementation practices.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Advanced Analytics and Statistical Modeling**


* Design and implement statistical analyses, predictive models, machine\-learning solutions, and analytical frameworks.
* Translate workforce and organizational questions into measurable hypotheses, appropriate methodologies, and actionable insights.
* Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, survival analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal inference.
* Perform feature engineering, variable selection, model tuning, validation, sensitivity testing, and performance evaluation.
* Apply explainability methods such as SHAP, feature attribution, and scenario analysis.
* Clearly document and communicate analytical assumptions, limitations, findings, and business implications.

### **Generative AI and Agentic Solutions**


* Design and build Generative AI applications, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation solutions, and agentic workflows.
* Implement tool calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs, multi\-turn interactions, and state management.
* Integrate foundation models through approved enterprise gateways and cloud platforms.
* Develop reusable prompts, agents, tools, evaluation components, and analytical services.
* Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, groundedness, retrieval quality, task completion, consistency, and hallucination risk.
* Test and optimize solutions for reliability, performance, latency, cost, and user experience.

### **Data Engineering and Solution Implementation**


* Partner with data engineers and architects to design data pipelines, analytical datasets, feature\-generation processes, APIs, and production integrations.
* Develop clean, reusable, and well\-documented Python and SQL code for analytical and AI solutions.
* Work with structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise sources.
* Implement data\-quality checks, logging, monitoring, error handling, and traceability within analytical workflows.
* Support the development of feature libraries, embedding pipelines, vector\-search capabilities, and model services.
* Move prototypes into scalable production solutions using established MLOps and LLMOps practices.

### **Governance and Responsible AI**


* Ensure solutions comply with applicable Model Risk Management, privacy, cybersecurity, data\-governance, and responsible AI requirements.
* Implement appropriate access controls, data entitlements, PII protections, cohort\-suppression rules, and analytical safeguards.
* Conduct model\-performance, explainability, bias, fairness, stability, and outcome testing.
* Support controls for prompt\-injection detection, approved tool use, source grounding, and model\-output validation.
* Prepare documentation covering methodologies, data dependencies, testing, limitations, controls, and implementation decisions.
* Partner with risk and control functions to address findings and support required reviews.

### **Technical Leadership and Collaboration**


* Serve as a technical lead for complex data\-science and AI initiatives while remaining a hands\-on individual contributor.
* Provide technical guidance and peer review to data scientists working on related solutions.
* Help establish standards for coding, analytical design, model validation, testing, documentation, and deployment.
* Partner with product managers, data engineers, architects, technology teams, and business stakeholders throughout implementation.
* Present complex technical concepts and analytical results in clear language for business and senior stakeholders.
* Contribute to delivery planning, solution design, technical decision\-making, and resolution of implementation issues.
  

  

**Qualifications and Required Skills**
--------------------------------------


### **Experience**


* Typically, six or more years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, advanced analytics, AI implementation, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience implementing analytical, machine\-learning, or AI solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Experience moving solutions from research and prototyping through validation, production deployment, and monitoring.
* Ability to lead complex technical work independently and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience operating within a regulated environment is beneficial.

### **Technical Expertise**


* Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, probability, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, experimentation, and model validation.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit\-learn, Statsmodels, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with data extraction, transformation, analytical cohort development, and data\-quality testing.
* Experience designing or implementing Generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-c

jobs.title: Director, Global Technology & Operations Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Global Technology \& Operations Strategy \& Transformation will help shape and execute strategic priorities across Global Technology \& Operations (GTO), with a significant focus on leading the AI program and translating strategy into measurable business outcomes.

  



The Director will lead the AI program across GTO, bringing together strategy, business case development, funding, program governance, technical delivery, adoption, and value realization. This includes managing AI program funding, ensuring funding is directed to the appropriate initiatives and teams, and maintaining visibility into how initiatives are progressing against delivery commitments, defined success criteria, and approved budgets.

  



Working closely with the VP of GTO and senior stakeholders across Business, Technology, Enterprise AI, Finance, and Risk, the Director will provide an integrated view of the AI program, drive accountability across teams, identify areas requiring leadership attention, and enable informed decisions on priorities, funding, execution, and outcomes.

  



The Director will also help shape how GTO delivers its AI agenda, establishing approaches to prioritize and sequence initiatives, accelerate execution, and scale reusable AI capabilities across segments and countries. This includes helping establish a practical path from opportunity identification through development, production, and adoption, while focusing resources on initiatives that can deliver the greatest strategic and business impact.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* **GTO Strategy \& Transformation:** Partner with the VP of GTO and senior leaders to translate strategic priorities into executable strategies, roadmaps, initiatives, and measurable outcomes. Connect priorities across teams, identify opportunities and risks, and provide insights and recommendations to support executive decision\-making.
* **AI Program Leadership \& Governance:** Lead the end\-to\-end AI and Automation program across GTO, establishing a single integrated view of initiatives, priorities, dependencies, funding, and outcomes. Establish program governance and operating rhythms and work across Product Owners, Segment Leads, Technology, and business and functional partners to drive execution, alignment, and accountability.
* **AI Strategy, Prioritization \& Delivery Approach:** Help define how GTO identifies, assesses, prioritizes, sequences, and delivers AI initiatives. Develop practical prioritization and delivery approaches that consider strategic alignment, business value, delivery readiness, scalability, complexity, funding requirements, dependencies, and risk. Continuously assess the portfolio to ensure resources remain focused on the highest\-value opportunities and identify where initiatives should be accelerated, repositioned, or deprioritized.
* **Business Case \& AI Program Funding:** Lead the planning, mobilization, and partner engagement required to develop business cases for AI execution and future funding, including cost\-benefit analysis, expected outcomes, success criteria, delivery requirements, and risk considerations. Manage AI program funding and recommend allocation or reallocation across initiatives and teams based on strategic priorities, expected value, delivery readiness, and performance.
* **Delivery Excellence, Performance \& Value Realization:** Oversee AI initiatives across technical delivery, business outcomes, adoption, success criteria, budget utilization, risks, and dependencies. Assess whether initiatives are delivering against their original commitments, drive accountability for results, and identify where intervention, reprioritization, or funding adjustments are required. Ensure realized outcomes can be traced back to approved business cases and defined success measures.
* **Executive Reporting \& Stakeholder Management:** Provide the VP of GTO and senior leadership with a consolidated view of the AI program, including roadmap progress, funding utilization, delivery performance, value realization, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. Maintain effective engagement across sponsors, segments, Technology, Enterprise AI, Finance, Risk, and other partners, translating complex information into clear executive insights and recommendations.
* **AI\-Driven Transformation \& Reusable Capabilities:** Identify opportunities to fundamentally redesign processes and ways of working through AI and Automation, moving beyond incremental improvements. Drive the development, reuse, and adoption of scalable AI capabilities, standards, playbooks, and common approaches that accelerate delivery and reduce duplication across GTO.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 8\+ years of experience across strategy and transformation, technology, AI, program management, product management, or related disciplines, with demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale AI, Automation, technology, innovation, or transformation programs, including program governance, prioritization, funding, delivery oversight, and performance management.
* Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience translating strategy into prioritized programs, roadmaps, business cases, funding recommendations, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong financial acumen, including experience developing and evaluating business cases, cost\-benefit analysis, managing budgets and funding, establishing success measures, and assessing value realization.
* Strong understanding of AI platforms and modern AI solution patterns, with sufficient technical fluency to understand delivery plans, challenge assumptions, assess dependencies and risks, and engage credibly with Technology and AI leaders.

jobs.company: Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA)
jobs.title: Director, Transformation & Regulatory Modernization
jobs.description:
At FSRA, our vision is to ensure financial safety, fairness, and choice for Ontarians. As a financial services regulator, we’re passionate about protecting consumers. Our principles\-based approach means we can quickly and effectively respond to the changing needs of consumers and the industry.

  

Our team combines industry expertise with commitment to public service. We attract individuals who are interested in meaningful work and who measure success through outcomes, not inputs.

  

At FSRA, we invest in the personal and professional growth of our team. We offer a competitive compensation package that includes an employer\-matched defined benefit pension plan, and a comprehensive and competitive benefits plan. We prioritize learning and development, wellbeing, diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging, and community giving.

  

Join FSRA and help us shape the future of regulation for generations to come!

**Job Description:**

**Hiring Range:** *$149,00\-$199,00 (hiring range and will be determined based on the successful candidate's qualifications, skills, and relevant experience)*

 **PURPOSE OF POSITION**


To provide strategic leadership, business ownership, and program direction for FSRA’s Property \& Casualty Auto Transformation Program, a multi\-year initiative to modernize auto insurance regulation through the implementation of a new supervisory technology platform and future\-state operating model.

  

The position leads the design, implementation, change management, benefits realization, and operational transition required to enable FSRA’s future Auto Insurance Supervisory Model, including insurer accreditation, risk\-based supervision, advanced analytics, streamlined regulatory processes, and enhanced market oversight. Working collaboratively with internal business areas, technology partners, system integrators, insurers, and other stakeholders, the position supports FSRA’s broader modernization agenda by advancing innovative, data\-driven, automated, and sustainable supervisory approaches that strengthen regulatory effectiveness and improve consumer outcomes in Ontario.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

 **Auto Transformation Program Leadership**

* Lead the delivery of FSRA's Auto Transformation Program, ensuring successful implementation of the new supervisory technology platform, associated business processes, and future\-state operating model.
* Establish and maintain program governance, executive reporting, performance measures, and oversight mechanisms to support successful delivery.
* Manage program scope, budget, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and approved business outcomes.
* Lead implementation planning, readiness assessments, operational transition activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on program direction, delivery risks, and transformation opportunities.

 **Supervisory Modernization and Business Transformation**

* Lead the design of the future\-state supervisory operating model supporting risk\-based regulation and insurer accreditation.
* Work across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, and technology teams to redesign business processes and improve regulatory effectiveness.
* Ensure the transformation supports enhanced supervisory capabilities, proactive oversight, market intelligence, and consumer outcome monitoring.
* Drive process simplification, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across regulatory operations.

 **Technology Enablement and Innovation**

* Partner with Information Technology, vendors, and system integrators to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions.
* Champion the use of automation, artificial intelligence, workflow technologies, and advanced analytics to improve supervisory effectiveness and efficiency.
* Guide development of capabilities including risk\-based filing triage and decisioning, regulatory workflow and case management, supervisory analytics and market intelligence, AI\-assisted supervision, digital insurer experience and self\-service functionality and enterprise reporting and regulatory intelligence capabilities.

 **Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership**

* Serve as the primary business lead for stakeholder engagement related to the transformation program.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, industry associations, technology partners, and other stakeholders.
* Lead organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption activities required to support successful implementation.
* Represent FSRA at industry forums, conferences, working groups, and stakeholder engagements related to regulatory modernization and supervisory transformation.

 **Benefits Realization and Business Performance**

* Monitor achievement of expected outcomes, including reduced filing review cycle times, increased supervisory capacity, improved stakeholder experience, enhanced regulatory intelligence, greater operational efficiency and improved market oversight capabilities.
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive governance and performance management framework, including KPI tracking, outcome measurement, benefits realization, and executive reporting, to ensure delivery of strategic objectives and sustainable transformation outcomes

 **Leadership and People Management**

* Lead and develop a team responsible for transformation delivery, business modernization, and strategic initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, data, and technology teams.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of FSRA's Auto Insurance Supervisory Model and broader regulatory modernization efforts.
* Champion innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence\-based decision\-making.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* University degre

jobs.title: Director, Information Technology & Enterprise Systems
jobs.description:
**Lead Transformation. Drive Digital Innovation. Shape the Future.**



Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and play a pivotal role in shaping the institution's technology roadmap, enterprise systems strategy, and digital future.


**About the Role**



This role requires a leader who combines strategic thinking, business partnership, and enterprise technology expertise with a passion for transformation and continuous improvement.



The successful candidate will lead one of the organization's most significant transformation initiatives, overseeing the implementation, optimization, and long\-term success of the Workday ERP platform while providing leadership for IT operations and ensuring secure, reliable, and high\-quality technology services.


**Title:** Director, Information Technology \& Enterprise Systems  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  

**Department:** Information Technology \& Information Systems (IT/IS)  

**Reporting to**: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  

**Location:** Toronto, Ontario
  

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes  

**Compensation Range:** $120,000 \- $150,000 annually


**Why Join IBU**



Located in downtown Toronto, IBU is one of Canada's fastest\-growing universities, offering a dynamic academic and professional environment driven by innovation, research, and academic excellence. By joining IBU, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, support high\-impact initiatives, and contribute directly to the success and growth of a dynamic and evolving institution.


**What You'll Do**


* Lead the implementation, optimization, and long\-term management of the Workday platform and other enterprise applications.
* Develop and execute the organization's enterprise systems and technology roadmap aligned with strategic priorities.
* Guide organizational change efforts related to technology initiatives through effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and user adoption programs.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, service delivery, and user experience across the institution.
* Oversee enterprise applications supporting Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Student Services, and other core business functions.
* Establish strong governance, data integrity, reporting, and business process improvement practices across enterprise systems.
* Provide leadership for IT operations, ensuring secure, reliable, and high\-quality technology services.
* Lead cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of IT support and enterprise systems professionals.
* Manage technology vendors, contracts, budgets, and external partners to maximize value and service quality.


**What You Bring/Who You Are**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology leadership, ERP implementations, and digital transformation initiatives, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven success leading large\-scale ERP implementation, optimization, or modernization programs, with experience across the full project lifecycle.
* Experience managing enterprise applications supporting Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Student Information Systems, or other critical business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, drive organizational change, and build strong partnerships with diverse stakeholders.
* Experience developing technology strategies, governance frameworks, service delivery models, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and make effective decisions in fast\-paced, high\-impact environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Direct experience leading a full\-cycle Workday implementation or major Workday transformation initiative.
* Experience in higher education, post\-secondary institutions, or similarly complex service\-oriented organizations, including knowledge of student systems, registrar functions, enrollment management, and academic operations.
* Certifications Considered Assets: Workday implementation, administration, or functional certifications, Microsoft Power Platform certifications, ITIL, PMP, Agile, or similar project/service management certifications.

  


**Additional Information**



To support the overall well\-being and success of our employees, IBU offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package, which may include the following, based on role eligibility:


* 100% employer\-paid extended Health \& Dental benefits
* 24/7 access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and virtual healthcare services
* Life, Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D), and Long\-Term Disability insurance
* Competitive paid time off, starting at three weeks
* Tuition Benefit Program
* Access to preferred corporate membership rates with GoodLife Fitness
* Engaging employee appreciation and community\-building events

**IBU is an Equal Opportunity Employer**



IBU is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued, and respected. We are dedicated to the principles of equal opportunity and encourage applications regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. Please contact careers@ibu.ca if you require accommodation during the recruitment process.

All applications are reviewed by our HR team. We may use AI tools to support certain stages of the hiring process and do not replace human judgment. IBU is committed to the responsible and fair use of AI in compliance with applicable laws.

jobs.description:
Since 1953, Empower Simcoe has specialized in providing a wide range of programs and services for people and families throughout Simcoe County. We are looking for innovative, passionate, and dedicated employees. Our inclusive culture empowers all of us to Be, Belong and Thrive. If you are looking for a career where you can make a difference and feel proud of the work you do every day, you've come to the right place. Your future starts now at Empower Simcoe!


Empower Simcoe is searching for a bold, visionary **Director Digital SolutionsBusiness Growth** to drive our digital revolution! In this high\-impact role, you will spearhead our innovation agenda\-scouting emerging tech to modernize our ecosystem, supercharge service delivery, and elevate the daily employee experience. You won't just track sector trends; you will anticipate them. Collaborating directly with senior leadership and the Director of Information Technology, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and execution, ensuring our organization stays agile, modern, and fiercely future\-focused. If you live and breathe tech innovation, get excited about the boundless potential of artificial intelligence, and love turning complex data into real\-world organizational superpowers, this is the sandbox you've been looking for.

**Compensation Package:**

* Minimum starting rate of $49\.54 per hour; $96,603 annualized.
* 11 paid statutory holidays are observed.
* 4% vacation pay paid bi\-weekly during probationary period.
* Confidential employer paid Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members.




**Following the successful completion of probation:**

* Employer paid benefits (life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability benefits, health and dental).
* Group RRSP plan with Employer matched benefit up to 5% of gross earnings biweekly.
* Employer paid sick, personal leave and vacation time.
* Opportunity to work remotely up to 60% of scheduled hours.




**Minimum requirements of these positions include**:

* Proven successful completion of a degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, web development, business systems, or other related discipline, or an acceptable equivalent combination of education, skills and experience as determined by the employer.
* Minimum of 5 years progressive full\-time work experience in information technology, digital solutions, business systems.
* Demonstrated experience with design, development, and implementation of transformation initiatives, business development and purchased services.
* Established skills in developing and designing standards\-compliant, accessible web sites is required.

**The job duties listed below are an overview of the minimum requirements of the position. The individual will be responsible for, but not be limited to:**

**Strategic LeadershipBudgeting**

* Drive innovation by leading AI initiatives and digital transformation.
* Co\-author the Digital Solution roadmap in partnership with the President and CEO.
* Advise senior executives on emerging technology trends and future capabilities.
* Foster a data\-informed culture across the organization.
* Manage the Digital Solutions budget to optimize costs and IT expenses.




**Digital Solution ArchitectureDelivery**

* Translate business needs into concrete technical software requirements.
* Design and implement platforms while evaluating security, integrations, and user training.
* Assess digital capabilities to mitigate risks and identify improvement gaps.
* Collaborate with the IT Director to align solutions with existing tech capabilities.




**CommunicationsWeb Platforms**

* Advance equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility initiatives across all social, web, intranet, and podcast platforms.
* Oversee digital assets to ensure information accessibility and seamless online campaigns.
* Coordinate with IT on infrastructure, security, and web system dependencies.

* Directly oversee the Manager Business Growth to boost portfolio performance.
* Scale purchased services using automation, technology, and data analytics.
* Explore new revenue streams through digital offerings and social enterprise models.

* Manage direct reports including the Power ApplicationsArtificial Intelligence Lead and the Manager Business Growth.

jobs.title: AVP Business Operations - BWI Technology
jobs.description:
**Work Location:**

Toronto, Ontario, Canada
**Hours:**

37\.5
**Line of Business:**

Business Management, Strategy \& Support
**Pay Details:**

$160,000 \- $200,000 CAD
This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance.
TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.


As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.


**Job Description:**

The AVP, Business Operations for the BWI Techniology Team will act as Chief Operating Officer to the segment CIO.


**Depth and Scope**

* **Strategy \& Planning Services:** Orchestration of weekly/monthly/quarterly routines, creation of yearly objectives and operating targets. Develop an organization of trusted advisors embedded in the LOB. Ensure appropriate and consistent collaboration across all GTS and business functions, S\&P activities in support of the SLT execution of objectives \& goals. Build and standardize routines and processes that support speed, simplicity and agility in decision making and in taking action. Oversee transformation program activities; establishing standards \& guidelines for funding, metrics tracking, implement and communicate the target operating model, governance framework and competency requirements in collaboration with partners.

* **Data, Analytics \& Reporting Services:** Lead alignment to GTS processes, with associated metrics to align strategy to objectives \& deliverables. Deliver Business specific metrics and reporting which enable actionable decision support.
* **Resource Management and Forecasting\-** Partner with HR to create and maintain a strategic resource management model; building strategies to optimize growth while at the same time delivering on target resource mix, and transition work to reflect a sustainable full time resource complement. In addition providing key resourcing metrics like utilization and capacity through Clarity resource governance.
* **Leadership** : Coach, guide and influence senior leaders on strategy and planning, tools and techniques and operational implications to drive out efficiencies including talent and diversity goals.
* **TS Partners:** Foster a '1\-team' approach through collaboration across Business Operations, GTS teams and other support functions within the segment i.e. Communications \& HR
* **Client Interface:** Ensure managers are operating in a mission critical role and have a firm pulse on accountabilities coming to and from their leader(s).

* **Financial Governance:** Partner with Finance to ensure integrity in financial reporting, planning and forecasting, and achieve annual savings targets.
* **Workforce \& Real Estate Management:** Liaise with Technology Real Estate Senior Manager to create a sustainable location strategy.
* **Technology Partners:** collaboration with other support functions across GTS including, Delivery, Strategy, Business Management, and Enterprise Change Management

**Skills, Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Finance, accounting experience are an asset
* 10\+ years of related experience
* 5\+ years of people management experience

**Who We Are:**

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.


**Our Total Rewards Package**  

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well\-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well\-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

jobs.description:
**The Financial Advisory Team at Teneo**
----------------------------------------


Teneo’s global Financial Advisory business advises corporates, creditors and other financial stakeholders in situations of financial stress and distress. No two situations are the same. Our advice and approach is tailored to each situation and each client. At Teneo, we believe such occurrences present new opportunities for our clients. Opportunities to restore value, raise new capital, pivot in a new direction and ultimately, identify certainty amidst chaos. Teneo partners with clients to find viable opportunities that will protect and enhance value and help them to build strategies that will most benefit their business and/or investment goals.


Integrating the disciplines of financial advisory, management consulting, investor relations, strategic communications, government affairs, risk analysis and talent advisory, Teneo’s global Financial Advisory team guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress. We help address the challenges a business faces, whether that is targeted performance improvement to Financial Advisory, or delivering a route to recover value, our focus is delivering certainty from uncertainty.


Teneo is expanding its already established global Financial Advisory footprint, now in Canada. The Canadian Financial Advisory team will join forces with the already established Strategy and Communications platform which has offices in Toronto, Montreal and Calgary. We are hiring at several levels.


**The Role – Associate Director, Toronto**
------------------------------------------


This is an excellent opportunity to work alongside our established team who will support you to utilise and enhance your advisory skills and experience. You will work alongside some of the most experienced practitioners in the field advising the boards, management teams, lenders and shareholders of companies which are underperforming and/or facing any financial stress.


As an Associate Director / Director in the team, you will have the opportunity to work and lead on a diverse range of engagements across all sectors, with plenty of responsibility for leading workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting Directors and Managing Directors in client\-facing delivery.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Client Service


* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements.
* Manage parts or all of the engagement, providing support to the Managing Director/ Director (or often directly to Senior Managing Director) in managing external stakeholders.
* Managing insolvency engagements under the *Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act*, the *Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act and other statutes.*
* Support management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short term cash flow forecasts and Financial Advisory plans.
* Providing comprehensive financial restructuring and cash management services to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress\-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact\-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Establishment or enhancement of company finance functions and processes.
* Develop, analyse and present Financial Advisory options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling. Liaise with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.)
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.
* Apply an understanding of financial and risk management.

Knowledge Acquisition


* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and Leadership


* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on\-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business Development


* Start to own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Director/ Managing Director/Senior Managing Director\-led marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand engagments as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

**Key Skills \& Experience**
----------------------------


* Qualified accountant (CPA or equivalent), both time and exam qualified.
* Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank; as an analyst in a debt or special situations funds. An understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisors).
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options. A basic understanding of insolvency legislation and practice is not a prerequisite but helpful

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI\-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year\-over\-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.


We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times *each,* clear evidence of strong product\-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3\-5 tools in a consolidation \& efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI\-leader in the recruiting space.


And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best\-in\-class recruiting product toward a multi\-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category\-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.


We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote\-first, high\-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise \& Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!


You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

**About this Role**
-------------------


TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B\+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing \& CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers \& Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.


We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team \- West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

* **Own the revenue outcomes for the segment**, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large\-scale competitive replacement deals.
* **Build a high caliber team** in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.
* **Establish a reputation for excellence** by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering \& Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.


In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go\-to\-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

**You could be a great fit if:**
================================

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Lead Data Scientist will work hands\-on across the AI and analytics development lifecycle. The role will design analytical approaches, develop and validate models, build Generative AI and agentic workflows, and partner with data engineers and technology teams to implement scalable production solutions.


The successful candidate will combine strong data\-science expertise with practical engineering skills, enterprise implementation experience, and an understanding of governance requirements. The role will also provide technical guidance to other data scientists and help establish reusable methods, coding standards, and implementation practices.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Advanced Analytics and Statistical Modeling**


* Design and implement statistical analyses, predictive models, machine\-learning solutions, and analytical frameworks.
* Translate workforce and organizational questions into measurable hypotheses, appropriate methodologies, and actionable insights.
* Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, survival analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal inference.
* Perform feature engineering, variable selection, model tuning, validation, sensitivity testing, and performance evaluation.
* Apply explainability methods such as SHAP, feature attribution, and scenario analysis.
* Clearly document and communicate analytical assumptions, limitations, findings, and business implications.

### **Generative AI and Agentic Solutions**


* Design and build Generative AI applications, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation solutions, and agentic workflows.
* Implement tool calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs, multi\-turn interactions, and state management.
* Integrate foundation models through approved enterprise gateways and cloud platforms.
* Develop reusable prompts, agents, tools, evaluation components, and analytical services.
* Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, groundedness, retrieval quality, task completion, consistency, and hallucination risk.
* Test and optimize solutions for reliability, performance, latency, cost, and user experience.

### **Data Engineering and Solution Implementation**


* Partner with data engineers and architects to design data pipelines, analytical datasets, feature\-generation processes, APIs, and production integrations.
* Develop clean, reusable, and well\-documented Python and SQL code for analytical and AI solutions.
* Work with structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise sources.
* Implement data\-quality checks, logging, monitoring, error handling, and traceability within analytical workflows.
* Support the development of feature libraries, embedding pipelines, vector\-search capabilities, and model services.
* Move prototypes into scalable production solutions using established MLOps and LLMOps practices.

### **Governance and Responsible AI**


* Ensure solutions comply with applicable Model Risk Management, privacy, cybersecurity, data\-governance, and responsible AI requirements.
* Implement appropriate access controls, data entitlements, PII protections, cohort\-suppression rules, and analytical safeguards.
* Conduct model\-performance, explainability, bias, fairness, stability, and outcome testing.
* Support controls for prompt\-injection detection, approved tool use, source grounding, and model\-output validation.
* Prepare documentation covering methodologies, data dependencies, testing, limitations, controls, and implementation decisions.
* Partner with risk and control functions to address findings and support required reviews.

### **Technical Leadership and Collaboration**


* Serve as a technical lead for complex data\-science and AI initiatives while remaining a hands\-on individual contributor.
* Provide technical guidance and peer review to data scientists working on related solutions.
* Help establish standards for coding, analytical design, model validation, testing, documentation, and deployment.
* Partner with product managers, data engineers, architects, technology teams, and business stakeholders throughout implementation.
* Present complex technical concepts and analytical results in clear language for business and senior stakeholders.
* Contribute to delivery planning, solution design, technical decision\-making, and resolution of implementation issues.
  

  

**Qualifications and Required Skills**
--------------------------------------


### **Experience**


* Typically, six or more years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, advanced analytics, AI implementation, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience implementing analytical, machine\-learning, or AI solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Experience moving solutions from research and prototyping through validation, production deployment, and monitoring.
* Ability to lead complex technical work independently and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience operating within a regulated environment is beneficial.
